wiki.title: Bob Owen
wiki.extract: Robert "Bob" Owen is a politician serving as a member of the Louisiana Senate from the 1st district, which covers parts of St. Tammany, Orleans, Plaquemines, and St. Bernard Parishes. He previously served in the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing the 76th district from 2020 to 2024. He won the October 14, 2023 election for District 1 of the Louisiana State Senate.
